max: Quick shoutout to @elaine for staying late tonight and untangling the staging deploy — saved our demo tomorrow. Also left cookies in the kitchen :cookie: 
elaine: haha glad it helped. turned out to be a weird env var mismatch. thanks for holding down the fort everyone.
anna: legend. cookies were a lifesaver. :heart:
kai: +1 on the cookies. Also Elaine's `grep` skills are unmatched 😂
sophia: Huge thanks from product — this makes tomorrow much less stressful. If you want I can add the exact steps to the runbook so it doesn't surprise the next oncall.
dev-bot: Deployment fix applied to staging by @elaine (commit f3a9c2).
max: can we add a short note in #eng-ops runbook and maybe drop a couple kudos in Donut?
anna: added the bullet to the runbook, and created a follow-up ticket (ENGOPS-429).
elaine: pushed a tiny PR that adds env validation and a short comment — should help prevent this particular thing. no heavy lifting.
max: everyone drop an emoji if you're cool with a lunch for Elaine tomorrow? :raised_hands: :clap:
kai: also shoutout to @devops-team for the quick rollback assist earlier.
sophia: motion to buy Elaine lunch tomorrow — vote :thumbsup:
anna: :thumbsup:
max: :thumbsup: 
elaine: ok wow thanks y'all. i'll bring more cookies tomorrow (there's a vegan option too).
dev-bot: Reminder: 1748302800 - Oncall rotation changeover scheduled for tomorrow morning.
max: great. wrapping up here — appreciate the teamwork. good vibes all around :sparkles:
